full_judgment:
2. The facts relevant for the disposal of the Rule, in short, is that complainant Md. Muslimuddin filed a petition of complaint in the Court of Magistrate, Bogra on 18.12.1995 against 32 accused under sections 148/447/379 read with section 34 of the Penal Code alleging inter-alia that .99 acres of land appertains to plot no. 508 of CS khatian no. 26 of Mania Sonaidighi originally belonged to Kifatullah, the father of the complainant and on the death of Kifatullah and also in an family arrangement among the heirs of Kifaitullah the said entire property devolved upon the complainant Muslimuddin. 

 3. In the CS record of right the said .99 acres of land has been rightly recorded in plot no. 508 but in the map of CS operation the said quantity of.99 acres of land has not been projected. On the other hand .23 acres of land has been recorded in CS plot no. 504 of CS khatian no. 75 but inadvertently .73 acres of land of CS plot no. 508 has been shown with in the plot no. 504 in the map of CS operation although in the hal record of right .23 acres of land of plot no. 504 has been recorded in the name of accused no. 3, 4, 8 and 9 and the attested parcha has been prepared to that effect also.
